{{Quote|I tried to resist him but he was absolute evil. He told me he had captured you and would feed you to his hounds but I didn't reveal the boy's location. I tried&hellip;I tried&hellip;I just didn't have the strength. Once again, I have failed the Force&hellip;|Gel, to Jhara, on his interrogation by Tol Skaros|<ref name="COL" />}}
'''Gel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Gel went into hiding on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] and settled as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Gel sent a message to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] requesting that the Rebels take to safety the [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] [[Caeleb]], a child strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] who lived on Dalicron-4 close to Gel's [[Farm/Legends|farm]]. However, the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]] came to Dalicron-4 seeking Caeleb and [[Torture/Legends|interrogated]] Gel for information concerning the child's location. The Jedi was fatally injured and subsequently [[Death/Legends|died]] from his injuries.

==Biography==
===Fugitive Jedi===
Gel was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="COL" /> who was born between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[62 BBY/Legends|62 BBY]]<ref name="Dates" /> and served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Within the Order he [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]],<ref name="COL" /> a combat-orientated [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization.<ref name="SWRGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Following the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="COL" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a tumultuous conflict between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Gel took up arms on the side of the Republic.<ref name="COL" />

In the aftermath of the Clone Wars, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were outlawed and [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunted]] by the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="NEC" /> Gel went into hiding on the sparsely-populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and settled as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] travel from the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]]. He became a grandfather to the Force-sensitive female [[Jhara]], who dwelled with him at his farm, and he also came to watch over the [[Caeleb]], the prophesied "Child of Light," a [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] who lived in a nearby homestead. Gel on occasion spoke to Jhara of the place where Caeleb resided, a spot created by the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Duumas]] that was devoid of the Force, though he never took her there.<ref name="COL" />

===Saving Caeleb===
{{Quote|A man from the planet Dalicron-4 contacted us about a child that was strong in the Force.|Luke Skywalker, to the Rebels dispatched to make contact with Gel on Dalicron-4|<ref name="COL" />}}
Gel came to fear that the Empire<ref name="COL" /> and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="CSWE - Darth Vader">{{CSWECite|Vader, Darth|III|288}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] would learn of Caeleb and seek to exploit the boy for their own ends.<ref name="COL" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> the elderly Jedi sent a message to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], an anti-Imperial resistance movement, to request that the Rebel Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] come to Dalicron-4 and escort Caeleb and [[Caeleb's mother]] and [[Caeleb's father|father]] to a safer location. Gel then dispatched Jhara to Dalia to await Skywalker's arrival, with instructions to escort the Rebel Jedi to Gel's farm. However, Skywalker was unavailable to travel to Dalicron-4 and he assigned a group of Rebel agents to make contact with Gel in his stead.<ref name="COL" />

Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]] plotted to apprehend Caeleb and dispatched his apprentice, the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Tol Skaros]], to capture the child. Skaros confronted Gel at the Jedi's farm<ref name="COL" /> and the Whiphid's [[Nek/Legends|nek battle dogs]] assaulted the Jedi.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> In a bedroom of the farm, Skaros [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Gel and threatened to feed Jhara to the neks if the Jedi did not reveal Caeleb's location. Though Gel attempted to resist, he was not strong enough to fend off the Dark Jedi's assault and through the Force Skaros discerned Caeleb's location from the Jedi's mind. The Whiphid stabbed Gel in the chest and departed to hunt Caeleb, leaving the Jedi for [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Fatally injured, Gel retained partial consciousness despite loosing large amounts of [[Blood/Legends|blood]]; his body was shattered by the assault: his [[Limb/Legends|arms]] were broken in several places, his legs were twisted at odd angles and his face was bruised.<ref name="COL" />

In the wake of the attack, Jhara and the Rebels arrived at the farm and found the dying Gel. The Jedi expressed gratitude that his granddaughter was still alive and provided the Rebels details of Caeleb's location. With his last breaths, Gel pleaed that the Rebels save Caeleb, then passed away as a result of his wounds. Jhara wept uncontrollably at her grandfather's passing and placed his boy on a bed and covered it up. Jhara and the Rebels subsequently confronted Skaros and rescued Caeleb.<ref name="COL" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Jhara, my dear. Thank the Force he did not get you. The dark side is going for the boy. Caeleb must be saved.|Gel, to Jhara|<ref name="COL" />}}
After settling on Dalicron-4, Gel came to believe that he had failed as a Jedi. He was concerned for Caeleb's wellbeing and when Skaros forced the boy's location from the elderly Jedi, Gel believed that he had failed the Force again. He cared deeply for Jhara and was relieved to see her in the moments before his passing, having been concerned that she may have came to harm at Skaros' hands. He regarded his Whiphid assailant as pure evil.<ref name="COL" />

==Powers and abilities==
Gel was proficient in the power [[Sense Force|See Force]] and in the use of the Force to [[Tutaminis|dissipate energy]] and [[Force stealth|conceal]] his presence.<ref name="COL" />

==Equipment==
At his farm on Dalicron-4, Gel was equipped with a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] that he had retained from his Clone Wars service. He also carried on his person a bottle of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].<ref name="COL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gel featured in ''[[Child of Light]]'', a [[2000]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity and written by [[Lee Pickler]] as the opening instalment of [[RPGA]]'s [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]].<ref name="COL" /> He was subsequently referenced in the second<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and third adventures of the saga,<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']],<ref name="Light and Dark" /> published in [[2001]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> and [[2002]] respectively.<ref name="Light and Dark" />
